title: Horchata Panna Cotta with Toasted Almonds
description: A creamy panna cotta dessert flavored with horchata and topped with toasted almonds and a zesty twist.
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat the horchata over medium heat until warm.
In a blender or food processor, combine the warm horchata, cream cheese, and vanilla extract. Blend until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the sugar and lime zest.
Add the sugar mixture to the blender and blend until combined.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until set.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, sprinkle toasted almonds on top of each panna cotta.
Serve chilled and garnish with additional lime zest if desired.
